text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the beginning of Taiki<n>Shuttle's
training.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She was so happy to have a trainer<n>of her own. I
have to give it<n>everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But when I arrive at the meet-up spot,<n>Taiki is
nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Thirty minutes pass. I take out my<n>phone, hoping to
get in contact with<n>her, when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've been at the racecourse—figured<n>the races were
on from today. Sorry<n>'bout that!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'm just in time for training<n>though! Ain't
that grand!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Now that's a frown if I ever<n>saw one...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I see what the problem is! Were ya<n>feelin' a little
lonely?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No need to deny it! It's tough bein'<n>on your own. I
know that feeling all<n>too well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But don't ya worry! I won't leave ya<n>alone again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So let's get to training! I can handle<n>whatever ya
throw at me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I swear to make up for all the time we<n>lost 'cause I
was late—trust me!
choice_data_list: All right, let's get to work!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Just as she pumps herself up for<n>training...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's one of my friends<n>runnin' over there!
Howdy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, she isn't able to focus<n>for more than
two seconds.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is cheerful and<n>energetic—but it looks
like we may<n>have a bit of a bumpy road ahead of
us.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Today's training session<n>was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sorry I kept runnin' off to go see all<n>my friends.
choice_data_list: Well, we finished everything on our schedule.
Well, we finished everything on our schedule.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That regimen was just right for<n>me. I had so
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I just about forgot! Trainer,<n>would ya mind
comin' along with me<n>somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With a bright smile on her face, Taiki<n>Shuttle takes
me away.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We're here! All right...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What kinda milk do ya want, Trainer?<n>Your choice!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's right! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When you're down for a fight, a<n>glass of milk'll
make ya right! That's<n>my family motto!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Milk is awesome! It draws out your<n>true power, so
ya can grow up big<n>and strong!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I drank a ton of milk, and just look<n>how big I got!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You should start drinkin' milk too and<n>unleash your
full power!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: For the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki is her usual energetic and<n>unpredictable self,
but I can tell she's<n>really serious about this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Here's to victory!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, delicious! ♪ Nothin' like milk<n>when ya need a
power boost.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I bet my family back in Kentucky's<n>out milkin' the
cows like always,<n>waiting for me to make a name
for<n>myself!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to give 'em some good<n>news!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best to make that a reality!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's debut race is approaching<n>fast, so we need
to double up on our<n>training!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us vow to do our best on<n>the road
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I shouldn't be kickin' back too<n>much at a time
like this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer! Ready for what's up<n>next?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I've got more mottoes where that<n>one came from!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When you're down for a fight, a<n>glass of milk'll
make ya right!<n>Aaand...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Chow down on some big ol' steaks!<n>Eat as much
as you can take!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now that you've got the memo, let's<n>go!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If I want Taiki Shuttle to reach her<n>goals, I'll need to
match her energy!<n>This thought sticks with me for
the<n>rest of the day.
